apps.localizedDescription: Read the Bible in several translations, search it, mark words, take notes, write documents and prepare Bible studies. Your data stays on your phone. Beta: the iPhone version is new, please report what does not work.

versions.localizedDescription:
**Beta, iPhone (SideStore).** Install with SideStore, no paid Apple account needed. Step by step: https://github.com/Trofline/BibleStudy#on-the-phone

Add this source in SideStore: `https://trofline.github.io/BibleStudy/sidestore.json`

First iPhone version: please report what does not work. Same features as the Android beta, including syncing with your PC.
